title: location_report_ok
description: Report accepted (the rule allows it). applied true = the hub handed the fix to the integration. applied false = nothing changed in Home Assistant: the fix is older than the last applied one, or no integration took it (not connected); the app may send a newer fix later, and the same fix counts as new again once an integration is connected. Same body as the 200 answer of POST /api/client/location.

applied.description: true = handed to the integration; false = older than the last applied fix, or no integration took it.
